cards.subject: Grok 4.8 · real-world utility
cards.author: x-news
cards.name: X Trending
cards.text: Elon Musk assured fans that Grok 4.8 won't disappoint — prioritizing practical usefulness over benchmark chases. 2.5T-param model on a new C++ stack for agentic tasks.

cards.subject: Grok Bot agents
cards.author: x-news
cards.name: X Trending
cards.text: Musk says Grok 4.8 skips benchmark chasing for daily help. Users build Grok Bot agents for finance, video, playlists — hiring them like staff.

cards.subject: Grok Bot · 600k DAU
cards.author: x-news
cards.name: X Trending
cards.text: Grok Bot daily active users topped 600,000 — more than 6× two months ago. Shopping cards, subscription trackers, one-tap checkouts.

cards.subject: Tesla · SpaceX growth
cards.author: x-news
cards.name: X Trending
cards.text: Musk: 'Tesla will be very high too' after SpaceX's projected net-income growth. Special committees exploring deeper Tesla–SpaceX ties.

cards.subject: Optimus · human data
cards.author: x-news

cards.text: Tesla launches intensive Optimus training — workers in sensor suits feed real-world chores and factory moves. Limited production-quality units at Fremont.

cards.subject: Tesla–SpaceX merger odds

cards.text: Prediction markets ~65% on a Tesla–SpaceX merger by May 2027. Musk called it a good idea; independent committees exploring.

cards.subject: Terafab chip project

cards.text: Musk updates Terafab — joint Tesla/SpaceX/xAI semiconductor fab in Texas aiming at a terawatt of AI compute for Optimus, FSD, space data centers.
